deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness.description: DeepSeek Harness core runtime: Everything is a Plugin.
deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness.usage: npx @deepseek-ai/dsh starts the core; mount plugins with `dsh plugin --profile web add <source>`

zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui.description: A collection of plugins and skins for the DSH Web UI: task board, Git graph, right panel, mobile remote, whale-girl pet, live token stats, and skin center.
zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui.usage: dsh plugin --profile web add github:zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui, then restart Web

liustack/modlens.description: The first DeepSeek Harness vision plugin that gives text-only models eyes: paste an image to get structured JSON evidence (OCR, layout, and more).
liustack/modlens.usage: dsh plugin add @liustack/modlens (npm); paste an image to let the text-only model see

ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI.description: Claude Code-style full-screen terminal TUI plugin: pixel whale header, live work status line, streamed thinking, double-Esc rollback, context progress bar, and TPS dashboard.
ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI.usage: dsh plugin --profile tui add github:ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI (one-command npm install)

omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar.description: A complete sidebar workspace: file management and preview, embedded browser, real terminal, Git panel, background jobs page, and third-party tab registration.

Anionex/dsh-vision-toolkit.description: Brings agent-vision-toolkit into DSH as a native Profile Bundle: intent-aware image Q&A, long screenshot OCR, UI restoration, pixel verification, and other vision tools.

liustack/modsearch.description: A web search plugin that connects text-only models to the internet: search the web or X and return structured JSON evidence (search, fetch, cite).

omdsh-dev/dsh-at-file.description: Codex-style @file mentions: search workspace files from the input, press Enter to attach, and inject file contents when sending.

omdsh-dev/dsh-open-in-vscode.description: Opens VS Code in the current directory directly from the sidebar workspace menu in the DSH Web GUI.

omdsh-dev/dsh-notification.description: Sends a desktop notification when a DeepSeek Harness session completes, with rules for result type and keywords.

Anionex/dsh-turn-rewind.description: A conversation and code state rollback plugin based on a persistent Change Ledger.

csyangwen/dsh-memory-evolve.description: A plugin-only cross-session long-term memory and background self-evolution system: five-track memory, Git branch awareness, skill self-evolution, four-track tasks, session broadcast, and search.

omdsh-dev/dsh-genui.description: Renders interactive UI components in assistant replies: layouts, charts, forms, quizzes, mermaid, and more, inlined through dsh-ui fences.

Lum1104/dsh-browser.description: A Chrome sidebar extension and bridge plugin that lets DSH control the browser you are already using without vision capabilities.
Lum1104/dsh-browser.usage: Run scripts/install.sh to install the Chrome MV3 extension and plugin bridge

icetomoyo/dsh_workflow.description: Upgrades DSH's one-off multi-agent scheduling into a Workflow layer that can be generated, saved, governed, observed, and recovered.

vlln/whale-girl.description: A DSH Web GUI desktop pet plugin in QQ-pet style: a floating, draggable companion in the lower-right corner that you can feed and play with.

hust-open-atom-club/oh-dsh.description: An all-in-one DeepSeek Harness community distribution: unified desktop, Web UI, and TUI experiences with layered installation.
hust-open-atom-club/oh-dsh.usage: Use the desktop/Web/TUI install scripts in the README to install the distribution

Ruler4396/dsh-launcher.description: A lightweight Windows launcher for DeepSeek Harness: starts at login, runs in a small standalone window, and opens with a double click.
Ruler4396/dsh-launcher.usage: Download the .msi or portable ZIP from Releases and double-click to run

ZSeven-W/dsh-openpencil.description: OpenPencil design preview and editing plugin: preview, inspect, and edit real .op documents in a session.

Nagi-ovo/dsh-visualize.description: In-conversation generative UI plugin: the model draws interactive HTML cards directly into the conversation flow for simulators, charts, comparison panels, and UI mockups.

NanmiCoder/dsh-agent-teams.description: AgentTeams multi-agent teamwork plugin: one sentence drives a team to complete a goal, with a live team activity panel in the top-right of the Web GUI.

0xsline/awesome-deepseek-harness.description: A curated DeepSeek Harness ecosystem list: plugins, tools, and infrastructure from dsh-external/hub and public dsh-plugin topics.
0xsline/awesome-deepseek-harness.usage: Open the website to browse the ecosystem list, or git clone it to read locally

AdamPlatin123/awesome-dsh-plugins.description: A front-index repository (Radar): automatically scans and discovers DSH plugin candidates, then moves tested candidates into the downstream curated directory repositories.
AdamPlatin123/awesome-dsh-plugins.usage: Open the website to view the automatic Radar scan and curated directories

bruc3van/awesome-dsh-plugin.description: Find the right DeepSeek Harness plugin in 30 seconds: tells you what problem a plugin solves, who it is for, and where to start.
bruc3van/awesome-dsh-plugin.usage: Open the website and choose plugins by the problem they solve

privacy_notes: Reads browser cookies/storage and sends them over the network

awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin.description: A curated list of plugins for DeepSeek Harness (dsh).

Small-tailqwq/dsh-deep-whale.description: DSH Web whale-girl skin series (Maid Atelier) - CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
privacy_notes: Reads environment variables that may contain sensitive information
security_notes: Uses dynamic code or subprocess execution

Nagi-ovo/dsh-ads.description: A DSH Web UI ad plugin in the style of a 2005 Chinese site: sidebar ads, in-conversation feed ads, corner pop-ups, and a close button whose real hit area is much smaller than it appears. All materials are fictional and domains are masked.
privacy_notes: Reads credential-like environment variables and sends them over the network, potentially leaking secrets

zhaoolee/notes.description: An open-source hammer-style notes app replicating the aesthetic of Smartisan Notes: one-command Docker private deployment, skill calls, dsh plugin support, multi-tenancy, one-command WeChat article formatting, and image export for notes.
privacy_notes: Reads environment variables and accesses third-party endpoints; confirm that sensitive information is not sent externally
security_notes: Uses dynamic code or subprocess execution
